findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_email_headers · Private data: check_spf, check_dkim, check_dmarc, check_tls_rpt, check_mta_sts, check_bimi, check_dane · Public sink: check_mx, analyze_email_headers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_email_headers · Private data: check_spf, check_dkim, check_dmarc, check_tls_rpt, check_mta_sts, check_bimi, check_dane · Public sink: check_mx, analyze_email_headers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
